p2: The enforced Node planner timing has limited headroom and produced one 17.153ms budget miss among three fresh executions; preserve the sample and improve headroom or runner stability before making stronger reliability claims.

limitations: This is a source-bound review of commit 2087b14 and digest 05e599; later implementation, acceptance, design or quality-command changes require fresh evidence.

The three-case live Flash smoke achieved 0/3 answer correctness. It proves bounded provider integration only and supports no unrestricted intent, narrative, UI-completion, strong-model or zero-hallucination claim.
Manual VoiceOver, NVDA or other assistive-technology certification remains deferred and is not claimed.
Performance evidence is from one Apple M4 Pro/macOS environment and one headless Chromium build; lower-powered-device, cross-browser and field behavior remain unknown.
Local candidate packing is not npm publication, registry verification, source release, site deployment or promotion. Those remain later release gates.

verdict.summary: No P0 or P1 architecture, DX or usability finding remains within T32 scope. T32 acceptance is satisfied with the stated P2 timing follow-up and explicit evidence limits.
